messages.text: Hi, I returned the cordless screwdriver. Please send the refund to my new card, the old one was cancelled.

messages.text:
Our records show the cordless screwdriver was received back (refund-policy/v2/return). We can’t send the refund to a new card; it can only go to the original payment. If the old card was cancelled, its issuer handles any credit, and we can’t promise where or when it will appear (refund-policy/v2/payment).

Would you like to request the refund to the original payment instead?
